mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved valuation metrics.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline >0.2pp and PAYEMS growth >50k fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high housing starts and strong consumer spending, S&P 500 forward returns turn positive as economic momentum peaks before slowdowns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200k and RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods (INDPRO > 102.5 for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a YoY decline in CPIAUCSL > 0.2pp signals easing price pressures that reduces central bank tightening risks, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY decline > 0.2pp and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.
